logger = logger.getChild(__name__)


@contextmanager
def lock_repo(repo: "Repo"):
    depth: int = repo._lock_depth
    repo._lock_depth += 1

    try:
        if depth > 0:
            yield
        else:
            with repo.lock:
                repo._reset()
                yield
